class.name: AIVisualSensor2D
class.brief_description: Reusable, deterministic single-target 2D vision sensor with field of view, range hysteresis, occlusion and memory.
class.description: Tracks whether an NPC can currently see one target and remembers its last visible position for a configurable duration after sight is lost. The caller supplies observer position, facing direction, target position, and a line-of-sight boolean obtained from its physics world (for example with [code]PhysicsDirectSpaceState2D.intersect_ray[/code]). The sensor does not perform collision queries by itself and does not own target Nodes. [code]sight_radius[/code] controls acquisition; [code]lose_sight_radius[/code] can be larger to avoid boundary flicker. A target that is occluded or outside the field of view is lost immediately but may remain in memory. Use [code]is_target_visible()[/code], [code]has_target_memory()[/code] and [code]get_last_known_position()[/code] to populate a [code]BehaviorTree[/code] blackboard. Create a separate instance per NPC/target pair.

method.name: observe
method.description: Updates visibility and memory once per physics or AI tick. Provide [code]false[/code] for blocked line of sight; [code]delta[/code] is elapsed seconds, not tick count. A zero forward vector cannot see anything outside the exact observer position unless the field of view is 360 degrees.

method.name: is_target_visible
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] only when the target passed range, FOV and LOS checks on the latest update.

method.name: has_target_memory
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while visible or until the configured memory duration expires.

method.name: get_last_known_position
method.description: Returns the most recent position observed while visible; returns [code]Vector2.ZERO[/code] after reset. Check [code]has_target_memory[/code] before relying on it.

method.name: get_memory_remaining
method.description: Returns the remaining seconds of target memory, refreshed while visible.

method.name: reset
method.description: Forgets the current target, last known position and memory countdown.

method.name: set_sight_radius
method.description: Sets the positive acquisition range and grows the lose-sight range if necessary.

method.name: set_lose_sight_radius
method.description: Sets the retention range; must be at least the acquisition radius.

method.name: set_field_of_view_degrees
method.description: Sets the full vision cone angle in degrees (more than 0 and no more than 360).

method.name: set_memory_duration
method.description: Sets how long the last known target position remains available after sight is lost.

members.member: Maximum detection range for new targets.
